# The Grossman Law Firm

> > California probate and trust litigation law firm serving Riverside, Temecula, and San Diego with expertise in estate administration, beneficiary rights, and trustee disputes.

The Grossman Law Firm, led by attorneys Scott Grossman and Zachary Hagenbuch, specializes in California probate law, trust litigation, and estate administration. The firm provides legal guidance on trustee duties, beneficiary rights, undue influence claims, will contests, and complex estate matters throughout Southern California.

## Key Topics

- Trust litigation
- Probate litigation
- California probate law
- Estate administration
- Beneficiary rights
- Trustee duties and compensation
- Undue influence
- Will vs trust differences
- Trust modifications
- Estate planning
- Joint tenancy accounts
- Trustee negligence
- Will and trust forgery
- Probate court procedures
- California trust law
